q: Match the words with their Turkish meanings.
why: capital başkent, landscape manzara (geniş bir arazinin görünüşü), journalist gazeteci, software yazılım, generous cömert demektir.

q: Match the adjectives with their Turkish meanings.
why: polite kibar, moody ruh hâli çabuk değişen (huysuz), shy utangaç, serious ciddi, forgetful unutkan demektir.

q: Match the words about homes with their Turkish meanings.
why: cosy küçük, sıcak ve rahat; spacious geniş, ferah; suburb şehir merkezinin dışındaki yerleşim (banliyö); penthouse yüksek bir binanın en üst katındaki lüks daire; appliance ev aleti (fırın, bulaşık makinesi gibi) demektir.

q: Match the words with their Turkish meanings.
why: detached house hiçbir eve bitişik olmayan müstakil ev; terraced house iki yanı diğer evlere bitişik sıra ev; recipe tarif; climate iklim; futuristic geleceğe ait gibi duran, çok modern demektir.

q: Match the school words with their Turkish meanings.
why: nursery kreş/anaokulu, courtyard etrafı binalarla çevrili avlu, boarding school yatılı okul, anxiety kaygı, perfectionist her şeyin kusursuz olmasını isteyen kişi demektir.

q: Match the words with their Turkish meanings.
why: qualification bir eğitimi bitirdiğini gösteren belge (yeterlilik), clay kil, achieve (hedefe) ulaşmak/başarmak, mention kısaca bahsetmek, various çeşitli demektir.

q: Match the verbs with their Turkish meanings.
why: back out söz verdiğin bir şeyden caymak, refuse reddetmek, encourage cesaretlendirmek, avoid kaçınmak, reduce azaltmak demektir.

q: Match the words with their Turkish meanings.
why: curiosity merak, tool el aleti, emotion duygu, solution çözüm, imagination hayal gücü demektir.

q: Match the words with their Turkish meanings.
why: empathy başkasının duygusunu anlama, cooperation iş birliği, awareness farkındalık, peer akran (yaşça ya da seviyece eşit kişi), abroad yurt dışında/yurt dışına demektir.

q: Which word matches the definition? "Someone who often can't remember things."
why: forgetful = unutkan. generous cömert, polite kibar, moody ruh hâli çabuk değişen demektir.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A person who writes news stories for newspapers, TV or websites."
why: journalist (gazeteci) haber yazar. photographer fotoğraf çeker, counsellor danışmanlık yapar.

q: Which word matches the definition? "Happy to give money, time or help to other people."
why: generous = cömert. Başkalarına parasını, zamanını, yardımını vermekten mutlu olan kişi.

q: Which verb matches the definition? "To give advice to people about their problems."
why: counsel = danışmanlık yapmak, tavsiye vermek. Okuldaki rehber öğretmen de counsellor'dır.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A house that is joined to the houses on both sides."
why: terraced house sıra evdir: iki yanı da komşu evlere bitişiktir. detached house hiçbir eve bitişik değildir.

q: Which verb matches the definition? "To take letters or parcels to a person or place."
why: deliver = teslim etmek, götürmek. Kargo ve mektuplar deliver edilir.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A machine in the house, such as a cooker or a dishwasher."
why: appliance = ev aleti. Fırın (cooker), bulaşık makinesi (dishwasher), elektrikli süpürge (hoover) birer appliance'tır.

q: Which verb matches the definition? "To make someone remember something."
why: remind = hatırlatmak. "The smart mirror reminds me of my schedule." (Akıllı ayna bana programımı hatırlatır.)

q: Which word matches the definition? "An open space with buildings or walls around it."
why: courtyard = avlu. canteen yemekhane, dormitory yatakhane, staffroom öğretmenler odasıdır.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A strong wish to know or learn something."
why: curiosity = merak. anxiety kaygı, empathy empati, confidence özgüven demektir.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A person of the same age or level as you."
why: peer = akran. "Exchange your paragraphs with your peer." (Paragrafını akranınla değiş.)

q: Which word matches the definition? "The ability to understand how another person feels."
why: empathy = empati, karşındakinin duygularını anlayabilme.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A school that teaches students the skills for a specific job."
why: vocational school = meslek okulu (meslek lisesi). Öğrenciler aşçılık, tamir, tasarım gibi bir mesleğin becerilerini öğrenir.

q: Which word matches the definition? "An official document that shows you have finished a course or have a skill."
why: qualification = yeterlilik, bir eğitimi tamamladığını gösteren belge. A diploma is a qualification.

q: Horror films aren't my cup of ___. I never watch them.
why: "Not my cup of tea" kalıbı "bana göre değil, pek sevmem" demektir. Kalıp hep "cup of tea" ile kurulur.

q: Many students ___ part in the school's sports day every year.
why: take part (in) = katılmak. "I take part in the chess tournament."

q: Kapadokya is famous ___ its hot-air balloons.
why: be famous for = ile ünlü olmak. "Paris is famous for the Eiffel Tower."

q: A dishwasher is great because it helps you ___ time.
why: save time = zaman kazanmak. waste/lose time zaman kaybetmek demektir; cümlenin anlamına ters düşer.

q: Emre promised to join the debate team, but he ___ out at the last minute.
why: back out = söz verdiğin bir şeyden caymak, vazgeçmek.

q: This blue bag doesn't belong ___ me. It's Elif's.
why: belong to = birine ait olmak. Bir gruba üye olmak için de kullanılır: "I belong to the chess club."

q: Every spring, the cherry trees in our garden ___.
why: blossom = çiçek açmak (isim olarak: ağaç çiçeği). Cherry blossom = kiraz çiçeği.

q: Living in another country for a year was a great ___ for me.
why: experience = deneyim (isim) ya da deneyimlemek (fiil).

q: Our new flat is very ___. It has five big rooms and a huge balcony.
why: spacious = geniş, ferah. Büyük odalar ve geniş balkon bunu destekliyor.

q: After practising every day, Ali feels ___ before the concert.
why: confident = kendinden emin. Çok çalışmak insanın kendine güvenini artırır. confidence ise isim hâlidir (özgüven).

q: "Think globally, act locally." What does this saying mean?
choices: Care about world problems and do something about them in your own community.
Travel abroad as often as you can.
Study only local subjects at school.
why: Dünyanın sorunlarını düşün ama kendi çevrende harekete geç: okulunda geri dönüşüm başlatmak gibi.

q: "Abroad" means "in or to another country".
why: abroad = yurt dışında, yurt dışına. "She travels abroad for work."

q: A "detached house" is joined to the house next to it.
why: Yanlış. detached house müstakil evdir, hiçbir eve bitişik değildir. Bitişik olan sıra ev terraced house'tur.

q: "Hoover" can be a verb or a noun. In which sentence is it a verb?
choices: I hoover the carpets every Saturday.
The hoover is in the cupboard.
Our new hoover is very quiet.
why: "I hoover the carpets" cümlesinde hoover fiildir (elektrik süpürgesiyle süpürmek). Diğerlerinde isimdir (elektrik süpürgesi).

q: In which sentence does "field" mean "an area of study or work"?
choices: She wants to work in the field of medicine.
The players are running onto the field.
Cows are eating grass in the field.
The farmer has a big field near the river.
why: field iki anlamlıdır: tarla/saha ya da çalışma alanı. "The field of medicine" tıp alanı demektir.

q: In which sentence does "stage" mean "a step in a process"?
choices: Nursery is the first stage of education.
The singers are on the stage.
The stage in the school hall is very big.
Ali is standing on the stage with his guitar.
why: stage hem sahne hem de bir sürecin aşaması demektir. Kreş, eğitimin ilk aşamasıdır (first stage).

q: Short breaks help me ___ my stress during exam week.
why: reduce = azaltmak. reduce anxiety/stress kaygıyı/stresi azaltmak.

q: Our teachers always ___ us to ask questions in class.
why: encourage = cesaretlendirmek, teşvik etmek. Kalıbı: encourage someone to do something.

q: Read the profile. What does Lena's father do?
src: Hi! I'm Lena and I'm from Germany. I live in Berlin, the capital city. It is famous for the Brandenburg Gate. I speak German and English. I'm cheerful and outgoing, but I'm sometimes forgetful. My mother is a journalist and my father develops software at an IT company. I usually walk to school. After school, I often watch documentaries about wildlife.
why: "My father develops software at an IT company": babası bir bilişim şirketinde yazılım geliştiriyor. Gazeteci olan annesi.

q: Match the countries with their capitals.
why: Türkiye – Ankara, Japan – Tokyo, India – New Delhi, Spain – Madrid, Turkmenistan – Ashgabat (Aşkabat).

q: Match the countries with the languages people speak there.
why: Ülke adı ile dil adı çoğu zaman farklıdır: Spain → Spanish, Japan → Japanese, Germany → German. Hindistan'da en yaygın dillerden biri Hindi'dir.

q: İstanbul is the capital of Türkiye.
why: Yanlış. Türkiye'nin başkenti Ankara'dır. İstanbul en kalabalık şehirdir.

q: Ayşe always says "please" and "thank you". She is very ___.
why: polite = kibar. Lütfen ve teşekkür ederim demek kibarlıktır.

q: Mert often leaves his keys and his lunch at home. He is ___.
why: forgetful = unutkan. Sık sık bir şeyleri evde unutuyor.

q: Selin feels nervous and quiet when she meets new people. She is ___ in new situations.
why: shy = utangaç. Yeni insanlarla tanışırken gergin ve sessiz.

q: My uncle buys presents for everyone and always helps his neighbours. He is very ___.
why: generous = cömert.

q: My brother is happy one minute and angry the next. He is quite ___.
why: moody = ruh hâli çabuk değişen, huysuz.

q: Match the jobs with what the people do.
why: journalist gazeteci, photographer fotoğrafçı, nurse hemşire, software engineer yazılım mühendisi, counsellor danışman/rehber öğretmen.

q: Put the dialogue in the correct order.
items: Hi, I'm Kenji. Where are you from?
I'm from Japan. I live in Tokyo.
Cool! What is Tokyo famous for?
It's famous for Tokyo Tower and Shibuya Crossing.
why: Önce tanışma ve soru gelir, "And you?" ile soru karşıya döner, sonra şehir hakkında konuşulur.

q: Translate into English.
src: Türkiye'denim ve Türkçe ile İngilizce konuşabiliyorum.
why: I am from + ülke; yetenek için can + fiil: I can speak … Dil adları büyük harfle yazılır.

q: Translate into English.
src: Hangi dilleri konuşabiliyorsun?
why: Soru kalıbı: What languages + can + you + speak?

q: Translate into English.
src: Babam bir hastanede çalışıyor ve annem bir giyim markası işletiyor.
why: Meslek ve iş rutinleri geniş zamanla anlatılır; he/she için fiile -s gelir: works, runs.

q: Read Ayla's profile and write four sentences about her, as in the example: "She is Ayla. She is from Kazakhstan."
src:
Name & Country: Ayla, Kazakhstan
Languages: Kazakh and English
Appearance: tall, curly brown hair
Personality: calm, generous
Routines: takes the bus to school, helps her mother
Hobbies: plays chess, watches films

rubric.t: Adını ve ülkesini yazdım (She is Ayla. She is from Kazakhstan.)
Konuştuğu dilleri can ile yazdım (She can speak Kazakh and English.)
Görünüşünü ve kişiliğini anlattım (She is tall and has curly hair. She is calm and generous.)
Rutinlerini ve hobilerini geniş zamanla, -s ekiyle yazdım (She takes the bus to school. She plays chess.)

model:
She is Ayla. She is from Kazakhstan.
She can speak Kazakh and English.
She is tall and has curly brown hair. She is calm and generous.
She takes the bus to school and helps her mother. She plays chess and watches films.
why: Her bilgiyi tam bir cümleye çevir. She/he ile geniş zamanda fiile -s gelmeyi unutma: takes, plays, watches.

q: Listen to Kerem introducing himself. Write the numbers you hear as digits.
tts: Hello! My name is Kerem and I'm sixteen years old. I live in Trabzon with my family. There are five people in my family. I usually get up at six forty-five and I take the bus at seven thirty. I can speak three languages: Turkish, English and a little German.
why: sixteen = 16, five = 5, six forty-five = 6:45, seven thirty = 7:30, three = 3. Saatleri 6:45 ya da 6.45 diye yazabilirsin.

why: wardrobe gardırop (yatak odası), cooker ocak/fırın (mutfak), sofa kanepe (oturma odası), dining table yemek masası (yemek odası), shower duş (banyo).

q: Robot hoovers are quiet. ___, they can clean every corner of the house.
why: Moreover (ayrıca, üstelik) aynı yönde ikinci bir artı ekler. However ve On the other hand zıtlık bildirir.

q: Smart ovens can cook for you. ___, they need the internet to work properly.
why: However (ancak) bir artının ardından bir eksi getirir: zıtlık.

q: Voice assistants are easy to use. ___, some people worry about their privacy.
why: On the other hand (öte yandan) karşıt bir görüş getirir. Moreover, also ve in addition ekleme yapar.

pairs: Some devices are easy to hack.
why: Enerji tasarrufu ve ev işlerini kolaylaştırmak avantajdır. Kurulumun pahalı olması ve kolayca hacklenebilmesi dezavantajdır.

q: Look at the situation: a robot hoover is moving around the living room. What is it doing?
choices: It cleans the carpet every day.
why: Şu anda olan bir eylemi sorduğumuz için şimdiki zaman: is + fiil-ing → It is cleaning the carpet.

why: Genel bir gerçek: geniş zaman. houses çoğul olduğu için fiiller -s almaz: save, make.

She is very good at cooking.

q: My grandparents' cottage is small, but it has a warm fireplace. It's really ___.
why: cosy = küçük, sıcak ve rahat. spacious (geniş) "small" ile çelişir.

q: Where is a suburb?
choices: outside the centre of a city, where people live
on the top floor of a tall building
in the middle of the city centre
why: suburb = banliyö, şehir merkezinin dışındaki yerleşim bölgesi.

q: Match the pictures with the smart home words.
why: Sesli asistanlarla ışıkları (lights), ısıtmayı (heating) ve kapıları (doors) kontrol edebiliriz.

q: "I hoover the carpets" means "I clean the carpets with a vacuum cleaner".
why: hoover fiil olarak elektrik süpürgesiyle süpürmek demektir.

q: Listen to the smart home assistant. Write the numbers you hear as digits.
tts: Good morning! It's six thirty. The temperature in the living room is twenty-one degrees. Today you have four lessons and a chess club meeting. The oven will start cooking at five o'clock, and the robot hoover is cleaning room number two.
why: six thirty = 6:30, twenty-one = 21, four = 4, five o'clock = 5, two = 2.

q: Write a short paragraph (80–120 words) about the advantages and disadvantages of smart houses.

rubric.t: Bir başlık ve konu cümlesi yazdım (Smart houses are becoming more popular today.)
En az iki avantaj yazdım (save energy, make chores easier…)
En az iki dezavantaj yazdım (expensive, need the internet, easy to hack…)
Bağlaçları doğru kullandım: Moreover, However, On the other hand
Görüşümü özetleyen bir sonuç cümlesi yazdım

model:
Smart Houses: Good or Bad?
Smart houses are becoming more and more popular today. They have both advantages and disadvantages. First, they save energy because the lights and heating turn off automatically. Moreover, robot hoovers and smart ovens make household chores easier, so people save time. On the other hand, smart devices are expensive to install. However, they need the internet to work properly, and some devices are easy to hack. In conclusion, I think smart houses make life more comfortable, but people must use them carefully.
why: Plan: başlık → konu cümlesi → avantajlar → dezavantajlar → sonuç. Bağlaçlarla cümleleri birbirine bağla.

q: Put the stages of education in the correct order (first → last).
why: Kreş (nursery) → ilkokul (primary) → ortaokul (lower secondary) → lise (upper secondary) → üniversite.

q: Match the school types with their descriptions.

focuses on science, technology, engineering and maths

q: Match the pictures with the school types.

q: In which type of school do parents pay for their children's education?

q: Nursery comes after primary school.
why: Yanlış. Nursery (kreş/anaokulu) ilkokuldan önce gelir.

q: "Upper secondary school" is "lise" in the Turkish education system.
why: Doğru. lower secondary school ortaokula, upper secondary school liseye karşılık gelir.

q: At a ___ school, students sleep in dormitories and eat their meals together.
why: boarding school = yatılı okul. Öğrenciler yatakhanede (dormitory) kalır.

Our school has a large courtyard, a canteen and a small library.

q: Which school would suit a student who loves acting and playing music?
why: fine arts school: resim, dans, tiyatro ve müzik eğitimi verir.

q: Which one is an extracurricular activity?
why: Extracurricular activities ders dışı etkinliklerdir: kulüpler, spor, müzik. Ödev, sınıf çalışması ve quiz düzenli (regular) etkinliklerdir.

q: Each student belongs to a year ___ and studies with the students of the same age.
why: year group = aynı yıl/sınıf düzeyindeki öğrenciler.

q: What does "graduate" mean?
choices: to finish school or university successfully
why: graduate = mezun olmak. Mezun olunca diploma alırsın.

q: Translate into English.
src: Yatılı okullarda öğrenciler yatakhanelerde uyur.
why: Genel bir gerçek: geniş zaman. students çoğul, fiil -s almaz: sleep.

q: Imagine you are a student at your dream school. Write a short paragraph (80–120 words) about a typical week there.

rubric.t: Okulun türünü yazdım (I go to a STEM / fine arts / boarding school…)
Düzenli etkinlikleri geniş zamanla anlattım (We have… every day.)
Ders dışı etkinlikleri ve kulüpleri yazdım
Şu an olan bir şeyi şimdiki zamanla anlattım (Right now, we are…)
Sıklık zarfı kullandım ve duygularımdan bahsettim (I always feel…)

model:
My Dream School
I go to a STEM boarding school by the sea. We have science and coding lessons every morning, and teachers usually give us projects instead of tests. After school, I often go to the robotics club, and on Fridays I play volleyball. Our school has a big lab, a library and a courtyard with trees. Right now, my friends and I are building a small robot for a competition. I sometimes feel nervous before presentations, but my teachers always encourage us, so I feel confident and happy here.
why: Geniş zaman (rutinler) + şimdiki zaman (şu an) + sıklık zarfları + konunun kelimeleri: puan buradan toplanır.

q: Match the places with what people do there.
why: staffroom öğretmenler odası, dormitory yatakhane, locker room soyunma odası, canteen yemekhane, prayer room mescit.

q: Match the pictures with the school places.
why: library kütüphane, canteen yemekhane, basketball court basketbol sahası, science lab fen laboratuvarı, dormitory yatakhane.

q: Match the pictures with the school clubs.
why: photography fotoğrafçılık, chess satranç, coding kodlama, art resim/sanat, robotics robotik kulübü.

q: Which sport uses a racket and a shuttlecock?
why: Badmintonda raket ve tüy top (shuttlecock) kullanılır. Voleybolda top ve file (net) vardır.

q: What is the opposite of homework?
why: homework evde yapılan ödev, classwork sınıfta yapılan çalışmadır.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A short test, often without warning."
why: quiz = kısa sınav, çoğu zaman habersiz yapılır.

q: What do students receive when they finish school successfully?
why: diploma okul bitince alınan belgedir. certificate ise bir kursu ya da beceriyi gösteren belgedir.

q: Mr Akın is giving a ___ about recycling in the school hall right now.
why: give a presentation = sunum yapmak.

q: Many students feel exam ___ and can't sleep well before big tests.
why: exam anxiety = sınav kaygısı. Kaygılı kişiye anxious ya da nervous denir.

q: Our school has a large ___ where students chat and play during breaks.
why: courtyard = avlu, okul bahçesi. Teneffüslerde öğrenciler burada vakit geçirir.

q: After PE, students take a shower and change their clothes in the ___.
why: locker room = soyunma odası; dolaplar (lockers) da buradadır.

q: Where do students cook food at school?
why: food technology room = mutfak atölyesi. Meslek okullarında öğrenciler burada yemek pişirir.

q: "Don't skive off too often!" What does "skive off" mean?
choices: to miss school or work without a good reason
why: skive off = okulu ya da işi kırmak, geçerli bir sebep olmadan gitmemek (gündelik İngiliz İngilizcesi).

q: "Let's catch up during lunch time!" What does the speaker want to do?
choices: meet and talk about each other's news
why: catch up (with someone) = bir araya gelip haberleşmek, sohbet etmek.

q: When do people usually say "Rise and shine!"?
choices: when they wake someone up in the morning
when they say goodbye at night
why: "Rise and shine!" = Hadi kalk, günaydın! Sabah birini uyandırırken neşeyle söylenir.

q: "Don't be in a rush!" means "Don't hurry!".
why: be in a rush = acelesi olmak. "Don't be in a rush" acele etme demektir.

q: Which word describes a person who wants everything to be perfect?
why: perfectionist = mükemmeliyetçi. "Teachers encourage us to avoid being perfectionists."

q: Which is a good way to cope with exam stress?
choices: planning your time and taking short breaks
why: Zamanını planlamak (time management), kısa molalar vermek ve rehber öğretmenle konuşmak kaygıyı azaltır.

q: A school counsellor helps students with their problems and gives advice.
why: counsellor = rehber öğretmen, psikolojik danışman. counsel tavsiye vermek demektir.

q: Put the dialogue in the correct order.
items: Excuse me, where is the canteen?
It's on the ground floor, next to the library.
Thanks! And where can I find the counsellor's office?
It's on the first floor, opposite the staffroom.
why: Önce yer sorulur, cevap verilir; teşekkürle birlikte ikinci soru gelir ve konuşma teşekkürle biter.

q: Listen to the school guide. Write the numbers you hear as digits.
tts: Welcome to Maple Hill School! The first bell rings at eight fifteen. We have seven lessons every day, and lunch starts at twelve thirty. The library is open until five o'clock. This year, forty-two students are in the robotics club.
why: eight fifteen = 8:15, seven = 7, twelve thirty = 12:30, five o'clock = 5, forty-two = 42.

q: Which word matches the definition? "A school for children aged about two to five."
why: nursery = kreş, anaokulu. pre-school education burada başlar.

q: My sister usually ___ the bus to school.
why: usually rutin bildirir → geniş zaman. she için fiile -s: takes.

q: Look! The students ___ volleyball on the court.
why: Look! şu an olanı gösterir → şimdiki zaman. students çoğul: are playing.

q: We ___ a maths quiz every Friday.
why: every Friday rutin → geniş zaman. we ile fiil yalın: have.

q: Be quiet! The headmaster ___ to the parents now.
why: now ve Be quiet! şu anı gösterir. headmaster tekil: is talking.

q: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
why: Bilimsel gerçekler geniş zamanla anlatılır: Water boils at 100 °C.

q: Right now, Ece ___ for her English exam in the library.
why: Right now → şimdiki zaman: is + studying.

q: ___ your brother usually play basketball after school?
why: Geniş zamanda he/she/it ile soru Does ile kurulur: Does he play…?

q: The pupils ___ the computers at the moment. They are reading books.
why: at the moment → şimdiki zaman olumsuz: aren't + using.

q: Which sentence describes an action happening now?
choices: The students are building a robot in the lab.
The students build a robot every term.
why: be + fiil-ing (are building) şu an olan, geçici eylemi anlatır.

q: Which sentence describes a routine?
choices: Kerem always checks his e-mails before school.
Kerem is checking his e-mails now.
Kerem is wearing a coat today.
why: always + geniş zaman bir rutini anlatır.

q: Which time expression goes with the present continuous?
why: right now, now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen! → şimdiki zaman. every day, usually, on Mondays → geniş zaman.

q: Which tense goes with each time expression?
why: Tekrarlanan zamanlar (every…, twice a week, on Saturdays) geniş zaman; şu an bildiren ifadeler şimdiki zaman ister.

q: "He usually plays football, but today he is practising the guitar." This sentence contrasts a routine with an action happening now.
why: usually plays → rutin; today he is practising → şu an/bugüne özel geçici durum.

q: Translate into English.
src: Şu anda kütüphanede ders çalışıyorum.
why: Şu an: am + studying. right now başta da sonda da olabilir.

q: Translate into English.
src: O her gün saat yedide kalkar.
why: Rutin: geniş zaman, she ile gets.

q: Translate into English.
src: Öğrenciler avluda futbol oynuyor.
why: Şu an olan eylem: are + playing.

q: Translate into English.
src: Annem bir hastanede çalışıyor.
why: Meslek ve iş yeri kalıcı durumdur → geniş zaman: works.

q: Every day Mia ___ to school, but today she ___ the bus because it ___.
why: Every day → walks (rutin); today → is taking (bugüne özel); şu an yağmur yağıyor → is raining.

q: Which sentence is WRONG?
why: know, like, want, need gibi durum fiilleri (state verbs) genelde -ing almaz: "I know the answer."

q: She ___ chocolate cake. It's her favourite.
why: like bir durum fiilidir, şimdiki zamanla kullanılmaz: She likes…

q: How often ___ you go to the art club?
why: How often sorusu geniş zamandır; you ile do kullanılır.

q: Answer: "I'm painting a picture for the art club." What is the question?
why: Cevap şimdiki zamanda, soru da şimdiki zaman olmalı: What are you doing? (What do you do? "Ne iş yaparsın?" demektir.)

q: Put the adverbs of frequency in order, from 100% to 0%.
why: always (%100) → usually → often → sometimes → rarely → never (%0).

q: I ___ miss school celebrations. I go to all of them!
why: Hepsine gidiyorsa hiç kaçırmıyordur: never miss.

q: Kaan is ___ late for school. It happens only once or twice a year.
why: Yılda bir iki kez → rarely (nadiren).

q: Which sentence is correct?
why: Sıklık zarfı be fiilinden sonra gelir: She is always on time.

q: Which sentence is correct?
choices: They are usually walk to school.
why: Sıklık zarfı ana fiilden önce gelir: They usually walk. they ile fiil -s almaz.

q: Translate into English.
src: Sınavlardan önce genellikle sakin müzik dinlerim.
why: Zarf ana fiilden önce: I usually listen…

q: Translate into English.
src: O asla ödevini unutmaz.
why: never zaten olumsuzdur; don't/doesn't eklenmez. he ile forgets.

q: About how often is "sometimes"?
why: sometimes ≈ %50. usually ≈ %90, often ≈ %70, rarely ≈ %10.

q: Adverbs of frequency come after the verb "be": "He is often tired."
why: be fiilinden sonra, diğer fiillerden önce gelirler: He is often tired. / He often feels tired.

q: "I don't never skip breakfast." is a correct sentence.
why: Yanlış. never zaten olumsuz anlam taşır; doğrusu: I never skip breakfast.

q: How ___ do you go to the gym?
why: Sıklığı How often ile sorarız.

q: Ece goes jogging every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Which sentence is true?
why: Haftada üç gün → often (sık sık).

q: "How often do you check your phone?" Which answer fits?
why: How often sorusuna sıklıkla cevap verilir: once a week, twice a day, every morning…

q: We have English lessons four ___ a week.
why: Kalıp: once, twice, three times, four times a week.

q: "Rarely" means "almost never".
why: rarely = nadiren, neredeyse hiç.

q: I ___ take short breaks when I feel tired, so I can focus again.
why: Mola verip tekrar odaklanmak her yorulduğunda yaptığı bir şey: always. never/rarely cümlenin devamıyla çelişir.

q: You are in the volleyball team, ___?
why: Olumlu cümle + olumsuz etiket. Cümlede are var → aren't you?

q: Your school has a big library, ___?
why: has ana fiil (geniş zaman, it) → doesn't it?

q: She isn't using her phone in class, ___?
why: Olumsuz cümle + olumlu etiket: isn't → is she?

q: They don't wear uniforms, ___?
why: Olumsuz cümle (don't) → olumlu etiket: do they?

q: We can use the lab after school, ___?
why: can olumlu → can't we?

q: The bell rings at half past three, ___?
why: rings (geniş zaman, it) → doesn't it?

q: Mr Demir is the new headmaster, ___?
why: Mr Demir → he; is olumlu → isn't he?

q: You play chess, ___?
why: play (geniş zaman, you) → don't you?

q: Ali and Deniz are preparing for the concert, ___?
why: Ali and Deniz → they; are preparing → aren't they?

q: I'm late again, ___?
why: Özel durum: I am → aren't I?

q: Let's go to the canteen, ___?
why: Let's ile başlayan önerilerin etiketi shall we? olur.

q: There is a prayer room in your school, ___?
why: There is → isn't there?

q: Your teachers support you, ___?
why: teachers → they; support geniş zaman → don't they?

q: Elif can't come to the party, ___?
why: can't olumsuz → olumlu etiket: can she?

q: What do we use question tags for?
choices: to talk about the future only
why: Question tag (… değil mi?) bilgiyi teyit etmek ya da kontrol etmek için kullanılır.

q: A positive sentence usually takes a negative tag, and a negative sentence takes a positive tag.
why: You are ready, aren't you? / You aren't ready, are you?

q: Translate into English.
src: Sen Mete'sin, değil mi?
why: are olumlu → aren't you? Etiketten önce virgül konur.

q: Translate into English.
src: O okula yürüyerek gitmiyor, değil mi?
why: doesn't olumsuz → does he?

q: The lights are off and nobody is answering the door. They ___ be at home.
why: Kanıtlar evde olmadıklarını gösteriyor → can't be (olamaz).

q: Elif's bag is still in the classroom, so she ___ be somewhere at school.
why: Çantası burada → okulda olmalı: must be.

q: The basketball court is full of cheering students. There ___ be a match.
why: Tezahürat yapan öğrenciler → maç olmalı: must be.

q: He ___ be hungry. He has just eaten a big lunch.
why: Az önce yemek yedi → aç olamaz: can't be.

q: Listen! I can hear a piano. The music teacher ___ be in the music hall.
why: Piyano sesi geliyor → müzik öğretmeni orada olmalı.

q: Ayşe got 100 in the test. She ___ be very happy.
why: Tam puan almış → çok mutlu olmalı.

q: That ___ be Mr Kaya. He is on holiday in Antalya this week.
why: Bu hafta tatilde → o olamaz: can't be.

q: Which sentence is a logical deduction?
choices: The library is silent. Everyone must be studying.
You mustn't run in the corridor.
Students mustn't use phones in class.
why: Çıkarım: kanıta dayanarak tahmin (must be / can't be). Diğerleri kural ve yasaktır.

q: In deductions, "mustn't" and "can't" mean the same thing.
why: Yanlış. Çıkarımın olumsuzu can't'tir. mustn't yasak bildirir: You mustn't cheat.

q: The prayer room is quiet and empty. What is the best deduction?
choices: There can't be anyone in it.
There must be many students in it.
There must be a lesson in it.
why: Sessiz ve boş → içeride kimse olamaz: can't be.

q: We use "must" in deductions when we are ___.
why: must be = olmalı (neredeyse eminiz, doğru). can't be = olamaz (neredeyse eminiz, yanlış).

q: Translate into English.
src: O çok yorgun olmalı.
why: must + be + sıfat.

q: Translate into English.
src: Bu doğru olamaz.
why: can't + be: olamaz.

q: Kerem is wearing his badminton kit. He ___ be going to the sports hall.
why: Badminton kıyafeti giymiş → spor salonuna gidiyor olmalı.

q: Everyone is wearing a coat and gloves. What is the best deduction?
choices: It must be very hot outside.
why: Mont ve eldiven → dışarısı soğuk olmalı.

q: Mr Arslan is very kind. All the students love ___.
why: Mr Arslan → he; fiilden sonra nesne hâli: him.

q: Can you help ___ with this project? We don't understand it.
why: We → nesne hâli us.

q: This is my new friend Ayla. Do you know ___?
why: Ayla → she → her.

q: These boxes are heavy. Can you carry ___?
why: boxes çoğul → them.

q: Ali and I are in the chess club. The coach trains ___ every Thursday.
why: Ali and I = we → nesne hâli us.

q: Match the subject pronouns with the object pronouns.
why: Özne → nesne: I → me, he → him, she → her, we → us, they → them. you ve it değişmez.

q: Is there ___ in the fridge? I'm hungry.
why: Sorularda genelde any- kullanılır: Is there anything…?

q: I'm bored. There's ___ to do here.
why: Sıkılmış → yapacak hiçbir şey yok: There's nothing to do. (Olumlu fiil + nothing.)

q: ___ in our class likes the new PE teacher. All the students love her.
why: Bütün öğrenciler → Everyone (herkes). Tekil fiil alır: likes.

q: I can't find my pen ___.
why: Olumsuz cümlede any-: can't … anywhere (hiçbir yerde).

q: There's ___ at the door. Can you open it?
why: Olumlu cümlede belirsiz bir kişi: someone (birisi).

q: He doesn't tell ___ about his plans.
why: Olumsuz fiil (doesn't) + anyone. "doesn't … no one" çift olumsuz olur, yanlıştır.

q: In which kinds of sentences do we usually use any- words (anything, anyone)?
why: any- soru ve olumsuz cümlelerde; some- olumlu cümlelerde; no- ise olumlu fiille olumsuz anlam verir.

q: "I know nothing about the trip." is correct because "nothing" goes with a positive verb.
why: nothing kendisi olumsuzdur, fiil olumlu kalır: I know nothing = I don't know anything.

q: Which sentence is WRONG?
choices: I don't know nothing about the trip.
I don't know anything about the trip.
I know nothing about the trip.
Do you know anything about the trip?
why: İngilizcede çift olumsuz kullanılmaz: don't + nothing yanlış.

q: Translate into English.
src: Öğretmen bize ilginç bir şey gösteriyor.
why: show + kişi (us) + şey (something). Sıfat something'den sonra gelir.

q: Translate into English.
src: Ona her şeyi anlatırım.
why: tell + kişi (her) + şey (everything).

q: My little brother is very curious. He asks ___ a lot of questions every day.
why: ask + kişi: nesne hâli me.

q: Read the text. What are the students making?
src: Zeynep is a student at a vocational school in Kayseri. This year, her class is working on an eTwinning project with students from Poland and Portugal. They are making a digital cookbook with recipes from each country. Every week, they talk online and share photos. Zeynep says the project improves her English and teaches her empathy and cooperation. Next summer, she wants to do an internship abroad with the support of the Ministry of National Education.
why: "They are making a digital cookbook with recipes from each country."

q: True, False or Not Mentioned? Zeynep's project partners are from Poland and Portugal.
src: Zeynep is a student at a vocational school in Kayseri. This year, her class is working on an eTwinning project with students from Poland and Portugal. They are making a digital cookbook with recipes from each country. Every week, they talk online and share photos. Zeynep says the project improves her English and teaches her empathy and cooperation. Next summer, she wants to do an internship abroad with the support of the Ministry of National Education.
why: Doğru: "with students from Poland and Portugal".

q: True, False or Not Mentioned? Zeynep visited Poland last year.
src: Zeynep is a student at a vocational school in Kayseri. This year, her class is working on an eTwinning project with students from Poland and Portugal. They are making a digital cookbook with recipes from each country. Every week, they talk online and share photos. Zeynep says the project improves her English and teaches her empathy and cooperation. Next summer, she wants to do an internship abroad with the support of the Ministry of National Education.
why: Metinde Zeynep'in Polonya'ya gittiği söylenmiyor; sadece gelecek yaz yurt dışında staj yapmak istiyor.

q: Which skills does the project help Zeynep develop?
src: Zeynep is a student at a vocational school in Kayseri. This year, her class is working on an eTwinning project with students from Poland and Portugal. They are making a digital cookbook with recipes from each country. Every week, they talk online and share photos. Zeynep says the project improves her English and teaches her empathy and cooperation. Next summer, she wants to do an internship abroad with the support of the Ministry of National Education.
why: "the project improves her English and teaches her empathy and cooperation."

q: What does it mean to be a global citizen?
choices: to understand the world, respect other cultures and work together
why: global citizen = dünya vatandaşı: dünyayı anlayan, farklı kültürlere saygı duyan ve birlikte çalışan kişi.

q: What are Erasmus+ and eTwinning?
why: Erasmus+ ve eTwinning, öğrenci ve öğretmenlerin Avrupa'daki akranlarıyla proje yaptığı uluslararası programlardır.

q: Many students want to study ___ to learn about other cultures.
why: study abroad = yurt dışında okumak.

q: Working on a project with students from five countries needs good ___.
why: cooperation = iş birliği.

q: Match the words with their Turkish meanings.
why: global citizen dünya vatandaşı, communicate iletişim kurmak, local yerel, opportunity fırsat, represent temsil etmek.

q: Which action fits "Think globally, act locally" best?
choices: starting a recycling campaign at your school
buying a new phone every year
why: Dünyanın çevre sorununu düşünüp kendi okulunda harekete geçmek tam olarak bu sözün anlamıdır.

q: Being a global citizen means only studying local subjects.
why: Yanlış. Yerel dersleri öğrenmenin yanında dünyayı anlamak ve farklı kültürlerden öğrenmek gerekir.

q: At the international fair, students ___ their country proudly.
why: represent = temsil etmek.

q: In our eTwinning project, our ___ are students of the same age from other countries.
why: peer = akran.

q: Translate into English.
src: Uluslararası projelere katılmak istiyorum.
why: take part in = katılmak. want to + fiil.

q: Digital tools help us ___ with people from different cultures.
why: communicate with = ile iletişim kurmak.

q: Wh- questions (What, Where, When…) usually have ___ intonation.
why: Wh- soruları genelde düşen tonla biter: Where is the library? ↘

q: Yes/No questions usually have ___ intonation.
why: Evet/hayır soruları genelde yükselen tonla biter: Do you go to the robotics club? ↗

q: Positive and negative statements usually have ___ intonation.
why: Düz cümleler düşen tonla biter: I love our school. ↘ / We don't have a pool. ↘

q: "You're coming to the concert, aren't you? ↗" What does the rising tag show?
choices: The speaker isn't sure and asks a real question.
The speaker is sure and expects agreement.
The speaker is giving an order.
why: Yükselen etiket ↗ gerçek bir sorudur: emin değilim, söyler misin?

q: "It's a lovely school, isn't it? ↘" What does the falling tag show?
choices: The speaker is sure and expects agreement.
The speaker isn't sure at all.
The speaker doesn't like the school.
The speaker wants a long answer.
why: Düşen etiket ↘: konuşan emin, sadece onay bekliyor.

q: Match the sentences with their usual intonation.
pairs: Do you like the robotics club?
I go to a boarding school.
why: Yes/No soruları ↗; Wh- soruları, olumlu ve olumsuz cümleler ↘.

q: "What time does the bell ring?" usually ends with rising intonation.
why: Yanlış. What ile başlayan bir Wh- sorusu olduğu için ton genelde düşer ↘.

q: "Are you in the chess club?" usually ends with rising intonation.
why: Doğru. Are ile başlayan Yes/No sorusu → ↗.
